items.raw_excerpt: Thai architects have called on Chiang Mai University to reconsider the demolition of the Ang Kaew Dormitory, considered a prime example of a bold, progressive milestone in the country’s architectural history.
items.summary_en: Thai architects are asking Chiang Mai University to reconsider tearing down the Ang Kaew Dormitory. The building is seen as a bold and progressive milestone in Thailand's architectural history. The fight to preserve it highlights the value of protecting local heritage.
items.summary_ko: 태국 건축가들이 치앙마이 대학에 앙카우 기숙사 철거 재검토를 요청하고 있습니다. 이 건물은 태국 건축사에서 대담하고 진보적인 이정표로 평가받고 있습니다. 지역 유산을 보호하는 가치를 강조하는 움직임입니다.
items.title_en: Architects fight to save historic dorm in Chiang Mai

items.raw_excerpt: If you thought you'd heard enough about eclipses for a while, here's a French expression that gives the word another meaning beyond astronomy.
items.summary_en: The Local France highlights the French verb s'éclipser, which means to slip away or escape quietly. The expression comes from the word for eclipse but is used in everyday French to describe sneaking off.
items.summary_ko: The Local France는 프랑스어 동사 s'éclipser를 소개합니다. 이 표현은 일식에서 따온 말이지만, 조용히 자리를 뜨거나 슬쩍 빠져나간다는 뜻으로 일상에서 자주 쓰입니다.
items.title_en: French Expression of the Day: S'éclipser
items.title_original: French Expression of the Day: S'éclipser

items.raw_excerpt: Mastering the Norwegian language involves overcoming numerous hurdles, big and small. Being aware of these pitfalls can help you on your road to fluency.
items.summary_en: Learning Norwegian has many small and big challenges. This article shares the most common mistakes people make when trying to become fluent. Knowing these errors can help language learners progress faster.
items.summary_ko: 노르웨이어를 배우는 과정에는 크고 작은 어려움이 많습니다. 이 기사에서는 유창함을 목표로 할 때 사람들이 가장 흔히 범하는 실수들을 소개합니다. 이러한 실수들을 미리 알아두면 언어 학습이 더 빨라집니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Every country has its own structure for an education system, and it might be one of the most daunting things for immigrants, especially those with children, to navigate. Here are the basics of Austria's education system.
items.summary_en: Austria organizes its education system differently from many other countries. Immigrants with children can find the rules hard to follow. This overview covers the key points foreigners need to understand.
items.summary_ko: 오스트리아의 교육 시스템은 나라마다 구조가 달라 이주하는 사람들에게 특히 혼란스러울 수 있습니다. 자녀가 있는 이주민은 더욱 어렵게 느낄 수 있습니다. 이 안내는 외국인이 꼭 알아야 할 핵심 내용을 담고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Austria's education system basics for newcomers
items.title_original: Four things foreigners in Austria need to know about the education system

items.raw_excerpt: It acted on the recommendations of the single-member inquiry commission and the report of the high-level technical committee constituted to probe alleged irregularities in the allotment of 50:50 alternative sites by the Mysuru Development Authority.
items.summary_en: The Karnataka state government canceled land site allotments made by the Mysuru Development Authority. The decision followed findings from an inquiry commission that uncovered irregularities in how the 50:50 alternative sites were assigned.
items.summary_ko: 카르나타카 주정부가 미소르개발청의 대체 부지 배정을 취소했다. 조사위원회가 50 대 50 대체 부지 배정 과정의 부정을 확인한 데 따른 결정이다.
items.title_en: Karnataka cancels Mysuru land allotments after probe finds irregularities

items.raw_excerpt: More than 2,000 Buddhists, monks and nuns gathered at Tay Thien Grand Mandala Stupa on August 19 for Vu Lan Festival, taking part in ceremonies honoring parents, ancestors, teachers and the nation.
items.summary_en: More than 2,000 Buddhists gathered at Tay Thien Grand Mandala Stupa on August 19 for Vu Lan Festival. They took part in ceremonies to honor parents, ancestors, teachers, and the nation.

items.raw_excerpt: It’s no secret that Mallorca has been suffering from overtourism for several years now and locals are becoming more and more frustrated with the situation. This time they're fighting with dinners instead of marches.
items.summary_en: Residents of Mallorca are frustrated with years of overtourism. Instead of marching in the streets, they are holding communal dinners in public squares. The peaceful gatherings bring locals together to share food and stand united against mass tourism.
items.summary_ko: 마요르카 주민들은 수년간의 과잉 관광에 좌절하고 있다. 거리에서 시위하는 대신 광장에서 공동 저녁 식사를 열고 있다. 이러한 평화로운 모임은 주민들을 하나로 모아 음식을 나누며 대량 관학에 단결해 맞서고 있다.
items.title_en: Mallorca Locals Fight Mass Tourism with Community Dinners

items.title_original: Mallorca locals fight mass tourism with communal dinners in squares

items.raw_excerpt: The Costa Vicentina Early Music Fest is returning to the western Algarve this August, bringing a week of concerts and cultural activities to Lagos, Sagres, Aljezur and Vila do Bispo.
items.summary_en: The Costa Vicentina Early Music Fest returns to the western Algarve in August. It brings a week of concerts and cultural activities to four towns. Performances take place in Lagos, Sagres, Aljezur, and Vila do Bispo.
